text: If you think dating is cooked in 2026, you're not exactly wrong. But giving up is the worst move you can make. Under many of my videos, I keep seeing the same comments. At this point, I'd rather stay single. Dating in 2026 is cooked. And things like that. And look, I get it. I've said it myself. Dating has probably never been as hard as it is today for the average guy. But the question is, is that the reason to give up? Is that the reason to just throw in the towel? Yes, we live in a world where there are a lot of women who are not suited to be a great girlfriend. But to be fair, there are also plenty of men who are far from boyfriend material. Insane expectations, unrealistic standards, lack of boundaries, lack of self-respect. All of that exists on the dating market. And yes, many videos, including mine, highlight these problems. But the point of my content is not to discourage you. It is the opposite. I want to say it again. Guys, there are still a lot of good women out there. And for the ladies, there are still many good men out there. But finding them today requires more effort than before. Guys, this is not a sprint. It's a marathon. Things that worked 50 years ago don't necessarily work today. Just studying, getting a job, and being a decent guy. That's a good base. But in today's world, it's often not enough. If you want to improve your dating life, you need to work on yourself in multiple areas. Your career, your hobbies, your appearance and style, your mindset, your principles, your self-respect, your self-love. And at the same time, you need to actively work on your dating life. Make better photos for your social networks and dating apps. Improve your social and texting skills. Go to parties, get-togethers, and other social events. Meet new people in general, and new ladies in particular. Approach women in public if you're willing to face that challenge. Go on dates. And if in the process you will be failing again and again, be rejected again and again, it means you're on the right track. Nobody said this would be easy. In fact, it's probably harder than ever. But step by step, you can improve your situation. Because in reality, you have two choices. You either give up and do nothing, or you keep working on yourself, fail and try again and again, every day becoming a better version of yourself and increasing your chances of building the life you actually want.
